LESSON: CHILD CUSTODY

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalat (Social Relations)
Topic 6.3: Child custody
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Child custody, part of Muamalat (Social Relations) in Grade 9 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: What are the rules that guide child custody in Islam?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. research online/available reference materials on the Islamic rules on child custody in groups and make notes,

2. discuss the significance of Islamic rules on child custody in groups and present in class.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. research online/available reference materials on the Islamic rules on child custody in groups and make notes,
2. discuss the significance of Islamic rules on child custody in groups and present in class.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Child custody together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy: the skill of interacting with digital technology is enhanced as the learners research online on the

Islamic rules that guide child custody in groups and make class presentations using PowerPoint.

• Communication and Collaboration: the skill of teamwork is enhanced as learners research on Islamic rules that

guide child custody in groups and present in class.

Values:
Respect is enhanced as learners research online on the Islamic rules that guide child custody in groups and make class

presentations using PowerPoint.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Child’s rights, childcare, and protection are enhanced as learners research online on the Islamic rules that guide child custody

in groups.
